# Johan Björkman

> Johan Björkman is an AI-fluent marketing communications (MarCom) professional based in the Helsinki metropolitan area, Finland. He helps brands with branding and strategy, 360 media, creative work, social media, PR, influencer marketing and performance marketing, combining human ideas with AI speed.

Key facts:

- Roles: Marketing and Social Media Specialist at Elisa; Digital Marketing and Social Media Manager at OnePlus (Finland); PR and campaign work at the agency Republic for clients including Sony PlayStation and Huawei.
- Markets: Finland and the Nordics, B2C and B2B.
- Portfolio: https://johanbjorkman.media/
- Contact: https://johanbjorkman.media/#contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/johansbjorkman/

## Case studies

- [Elisa](https://johanbjorkman.media/cases/elisa.html): Device and 5G marketing across B2C and B2B through the full retail calendar, from weekly promotions to Black Friday. Joint programmes with Samsung, Apple and Google; campaign creative from concept to graphics and copy; social media and influencers. Results: +14% average year-on-year growth in smartphone sales and a +4–5% annual gain in smartphone market share. Campaigns shown: Hintamyräkkä 2025 (summer price campaign) and Black Friday 2024.
- [OnePlus](https://johanbjorkman.media/cases/oneplus.html): Localized OnePlus HQ and EMEA product launches for Finland, owned OnePlus Finland's social media and community, and ran performance marketing and paid social. Results: a record market share of about 20% in Finland and 40,000+ Instagram followers gained. Campaigns shown: OnePlus 10 Pro launch (Helsinki, 2022), OnePlus 9 Series #TrueColorsFinland with Pantone, 5 years in Finland, and Nord launches and community events.
- [Republic](https://johanbjorkman.media/cases/republic.html): PR, influencer and campaign work for major tech and gaming clients including Sony PlayStation and Huawei, coordinated across Nordic stakeholders. Result: helped PlayStation keep #1 console market leadership in Finland.

## Services

- Marketing strategy and branding
- Campaign planning and 360 media
- Creative concepts, copy and AI-powered content production
- Social media, community and influencer marketing
- PR and events
- Performance marketing and paid social
